headline: Two Arrested In India Over Rajasthan Railway Track Explosion Case
seoTitle: Two Arrested In Rajasthan Railway Blast Case
metaDescription: Indian authorities arrested two suspects in Punjab linked to a November 3 railway track explosion in Rajasthan, citing ties to Pakistan-based handlers.
aiSummaryBullets: Two individuals were taken into custody in Gurdaspur, Punjab, following a November 3 railway track explosion in Rajasthan.
The Rajasthan Anti-Terrorism Squad reported that the suspects allegedly acted under instructions from handlers based in Pakistan.
Investigations suggest one suspect was recruited through a romantic relationship by a handler to facilitate the attack.
aiContextParagraph: On November 3, 2026, an explosion occurred on a railway track in Ramsinghpur, Rajasthan, prompting an investigation by the Rajasthan Anti-Terrorism Squad. Authorities recently apprehended two suspects, identified as Mahakdeep Kaur and Davinder Singh, in Gurdaspur, Punjab, in connection to the incident. Official reports indicate that the operation was coordinated by Pakistan-based handlers. According to law enforcement findings, the recruitment process involved the exploitation of a romantic relationship to involve one of the suspects in the conspiracy. The investigation remains ongoing as police look into the extent of the planning and the involvement of external actors. This incident is currently being examined by security agencies to determine the full scope of the attack, focusing on how the suspects were mobilized and the nature of their communications with the alleged handlers situated outside of India.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained visibility through reports from major news outlets detailing the connection between local arrests and alleged international handlers.
